name: Yuka
source:
Yuka, who grows up in a single-mother family, likes her young uncle like a dad. Yuka awakens to sex after an event on a summer day. Yuka masturbates while remembering the event.

The two meet again after a long time...
translation:
结花在单亲家庭中长大，把年轻叔叔当作父亲般喜欢。某个夏日发生的事件让结花觉醒于性。她一边回忆事件，一边自慰。

两人久别重逢……
